description: This file defines the TimesheetDateRule class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It implements a validation rule to check if a provided date is valid for a timesheet entry, ensuring it's not a future date and that no existing timesheet exists for the employee on that date.

classes.name: TimesheetDateRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a given date for timesheet entry is valid (not in the future and without an existing timesheet for the employee).

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the employee number for the validation rule.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation to ensure the date is not in the future and no timesheet exists for that date for the employee.
